title: Replay compares hook-enforced records with injected records
body:
Source: .krn/runs/research/sector-sweep-1119/report.md "S1" (arXiv 2611.19549: enforced 0 violations vs 21-55%; prompted 17pp worse, ns; 2611.24491).
Outcome: replay gains an "enforced" arm compiling the most-violated records to PreToolUse deny hooks, compared per record against injection; an S8 follow-up, not part of the confirmatory run.
Proof: `node evals/replay/run.ts --arms C,CE --units 1 --dry` prints rows for both arms.
